records.name: Empacer
records.tagline: The voice-first assistant for small business owners
records.description: Most small business owners face the same problem when trying to use AI tools: they don't have time for re-explaining their business in every chat. Empacer is designed to skip this part. Three questions at setup, then spoken requests become a ready plan and finished work: customer replies, social posts, invoices and more. Nothing is sent without the owner's approval.

records.name: Suno MCP
records.tagline: The music layerfor your AI stack
records.description: MCP stands for Model Context Protocol, an open standard that lets AI assistants work with other apps. The Suno MCP connects your Suno account to the AI assistants you already use, like ChatGPT and Claude. Once it’s connected, you can ask your assistant to make a song, extend it, cover it, and more, right in the conversation you’re already having! Your assistant can use everything you’ve already discussed (lyrics, a project, a video plan) so you don’t have to re-explain your idea.

records.name: Arco
records.tagline: GitHub and Linear issues, right inside your Codex
records.description: Arco is a free, open-source Codex plugin for managing GitHub and Linear issues. You can - View issues in chat, in a side panel, or full screen. - Create, close, and reopen issues. - Add comments. - Select passages from issues and add them to your next Codex prompt. Arco runs locally on your machine. No server hosting required🎻

records.name: Kin
records.tagline: The AI labs want to own you. Make them answer to you.
records.description: Let your AIs run free. Kin keeps them in check. Connect GitHub, Gmail or Stripe once, add Kin to ChatGPT, Claude or Cursor, and give each action a rule: Allow, Ask me or Block. Ask me waits for your OK on the web or your phone.

records.name: Confetti
records.tagline: Easiest way to build hardware gadgets using plain English
records.description: Making hardware used to take weeks of learning CAD, sourcing compatible parts, and writing firmware. With Confetti, it starts with a conversation. Create and edit designs, find components, and order printed parts straight to your doorstep. Start from scratch or remix a community project to make it your own.

records.name: Voxel51 Multimodal
records.tagline: Better data. Smarter robots. Repeat.
records.description: The real world is messy. Robots encounter unexpected situations and behave in ways you never anticipated. But every failure is a chance to teach your robot something new. The hard part? Sifting through hours of video and sensor data to figure out why your robot failed. Voxel51 is an end-to-end multimodal data platform that accelerates robot learning. Find the failures that matter, understand why they happened, and fill gaps in your training data to improve models faster. Try Voxel51 for free.

records.name: ChatInbox
records.tagline: Email that groups your inbox by contact
records.description: ChatInbox rebuilds the inbox around people instead of time. Every customer, vendor or friend becomes one conversation: full history, every file, whose turn it is. That is CRM-grade context inside your mailbox, across Gmail, Outlook, iCloud and any IMAP account, with newsletters and receipts filed into Feeds automatically. Three years of iteration, native on Mac, iPhone and iPad. Apple Intelligence powers drafting, summaries and triage on-device, so your mail never leaves your devices.

records.name: Viggle JST-2
records.tagline: JST-2: 3D scenes, characters and motion from one model
records.description: JST-2 is Viggle’s physics-native world foundation model for generating 3D scenes, characters and full-body motion in one shared world. Scenes take about one second, characters come from one image or text with motion built in, and motion comes from text or video. Try it free in the PINOC browser app, or use the API or MCP with agents like Claude Code. Benchmarks are Viggle’s own blind human tests.

records.name: JIMMY

records.name: Scape
records.tagline: An intelligent email inbox that works for you

records.name: Gologin Cloud Browser

It understands English, Hindi and Hinglish ("main kal tak bhej dunga" becomes a dated task). Unclear owners or dates are flagged, never guessed. REST API, webhooks and an MCP server. Free plan, no card; Pro ₹999/month ($12).

records.name: QuitPath
records.tagline: Quit smoking with a private, offline craving SOS
records.description: QuitPath helps you quit smoking one day at a time. Watch smoke-free time, money saved and health recovery add up live, ride out cravings with a four-minute SOS, and follow a 30-day plan. Free, no account, no ads, and everything stays on your iPhone.

records.name: YS LeadGen
records.tagline: Best WordPress Popup Plugin & Form Builder
records.description: YS LeadGen is an all-in-one WordPress popup and form builder that helps website owners capture leads, grow email lists, and increase conversions. Create exit-intent popups, newsletter forms, spin-to-win wheels, sticky bars, quizzes, and multi-step forms with an easy drag-and-drop editor. WooCommerce users can recover abandoned carts, offer discount coupons, and promote related products. Track performance with analytics and A/B testing, connect email marketing tools. No coding required!

records.name: Symmetric Consultancy
records.tagline: Pioneering corporate training
records.description: Leading Corporate Training Company that offers Corporate IT Training, Soft Skills Training, IT Project Consultancy and HR Services to its clients around the globe.

records.name: signoff-ui
records.tagline: Review what your agent changed, approve what it may do
records.description: signoff-ui is React components for the step where a person signs off on what an agent does. DiffReview gives the agent back each file with only the accepted hunks applied, the rejected hunks and the reviewer's comments. ApprovalCard shows exactly what will run and lets you approve once, for the session or always. For AI SDK 6 and 7, AG-UI and ACP agents, inside assistant-ui, AI Elements or your own chat. MIT licensed.

records.name: MGR Plumbing & Heating Ltd
records.tagline: mgrplumbing
records.description: Plumbers in Beaconsfield You Can Rely On for Boilers and Heating

records.name: OLE!
records.tagline: Catch The Thief
records.description: Gbera don snatch one madam bag for Oshodi bustop! Pursue am, pack the money wey dey fall. Plenty people don try catch am. Na you go do am?

records.name: Gootaku
records.tagline: Turn a prompt into manga, comic, GIF and anime clip panels
records.description: Type a scene and Gootaku draws it as a manga, comic, GIF or short anime video panel. Try one panel without signing up. Add speech balloons, reuse your own characters, share to the community. One-time token packs, no subscription. 9 languages and an iOS app.

records.name: Enter to Win $900: Free Giveaway, Random
records.tagline: Enter to Win $900: Free Giveaway, Random Winner
records.description: One random winner receives a $900 gift card. Fair draw, clear rules and a public announcement on November 2, 2026.

records.name: Aaghaz360
records.tagline: Every construction site, bill and approval on one screen
records.description: Construction companies run each site on paper registers, WhatsApp voice notes and an office spreadsheet. Once they have two or three jobs, the owner can't say what's owed, what's been spent, or which job is losing money until it's too late to fix.

records.name: Setlys
records.tagline: AI product photos where your product stays consistent
records.description: Setlys turns one product photo into a full photo shoot. Your product, cast and props live in a library and stay consistent across every scene. An AI judge checks each photo against your real product before delivery. Free to start.

records.name: FileConvertCenter
records.tagline: Free browser tools for PDFs, files, images and video
records.description: FileConvertCenter brings PDF, document, image, video, audio and text tools together in one browser-based workspace. Edit supported selectable PDF text, annotate or sign documents, convert file formats, and optimize images. Many tools run locally in the browser; check each tool page for its supported formats and limits.

records.name: adtec® Smooth
records.tagline: adtec® Smooth™ is a purely refractive EDOF IOLs
records.description: adtec® Smooth™ is a purely refractive EDOF IOLs For Presbyopia correction. Its wavefront – shaping architecture delivers extended range seamlesssly with little to no halos or glare.

records.name: Akili
records.tagline: The intelligence and operations platform for consumer brands
records.description: Akili helps marketing, CX and operations teams at multi-location consumer brands see how customers perceive every location, rank the fixes that grow revenue and cut churn, and prove they worked.
